sections.title: Front door
sections.blurb: What a player meets first: the title screen and the character creator, step by step.

sections.title: The HUD
sections.blurb: The default HUD on foot, at the wheel, at night, and each preset and situation as the F6 editor shows it (names on).

sections.title: Screens and panels
sections.blurb: Every full screen a player can open: pack, the paperdoll, the character sheet, crew, dialogue, travel, workshop, pulls, map, pause and settings.

sections.title: Vehicles
sections.blurb: Driving a car, a boat on waves, riders on a pickup bed, bikes, the big rigs and the trundle.

sections.title: On foot and in a fight
sections.blurb: Postures, a firefight with tracers, melee, thrown weapons and the explosion that follows.

sections.title: The infected
sections.blurb: Every breed with its vein colour, crawlers, the Choir-Touched, a horde, and the same at night.

sections.title: Kit and gadgets
sections.blurb: The things you look through and wear: night vision, the heat scope, flashlight, binoculars, gas mask, scanner, the dog's gear, car gadgets and the drone.

sections.title: Places and time of day
sections.blurb: Town streets at day and night, back alleys, the cemetery and a funeral, a bar, a hitchhiker, a storm drain, the military base, bounty boards.

sections.title: Terrain and roadsides
sections.blurb: Real elevation (canyon, river, forest hills), Florida swamp, and what stands beside the road in each region.
